title: Youth Farmers Seek Profit in Agriculture Expo
reason: The video discusses the challenges of transitioning from subsistence to commercial farming and the efforts to improve this through workshops and mindset change.

tasks.task: Explain the mindset change required for transitioning to commercial farming.

subtasks.text: Antoni Bambale expresses hope for profit in agriculture.
Officials believe the current mindset is hindering the transition to commercial farming.

tasks.task: Describe the objectives and activities of the agriculture expo.

subtasks.text: The expo aimed to help participants choose the right enterprises.
The expo addressed market linkages and access to capital.

tasks.task: Highlight the role of young people in agricultural improvement.

subtasks.text: Youth need to be involved in input distribution.
The expo helped familiarize youth with new technologies and services.
